title: Discrete-Time Integrator
text: Perform discrete-time integration or accumulation of signal, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Select data type mode; {Integrator method} sets the accumulation method Integration: Forward, {Gain value} sets the value to multiply with integrator input, {External reset} selects when to reset states to initial, {Initial condition source} sets the option to set initial condition using external signal, {Initial condition}, {Initial condition setting} selects where to apply the initial, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Limit output} limits block output values to specified, {Upper saturation limit} sets the upper limit, {Lower saturation limit} sets the lower limit, {Show saturation port} enables saturation output port, {Show state port} enables state output port, {Ignore limit and reset when linearizing} treats block as not resettable, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness}, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data, {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type, {State name} sets the unique name for block state and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} sets the option to require that state names resolve to signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: IC
ports.summary: Initial conditions of the states scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Discrete-time integration or accumulation of input scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Accumulation method Integration: Forward Euler (default) | Integration: Backward Euler | Integration: Trapezoidal | Accumulation: Forward Euler | Accumulation: Backward Euler | Accumulation: Trapezoidal

params.name: Gain value
params.values: Value to multiply with integrator input 1.0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: External reset
params.values: Select when to reset states to initial conditions none (default) | rising | falling | either | level | sampled level

params.name: Initial condition source
params.values: Option to set initial condition using external signal internal (default) | external

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial condition of states 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial condition setting
params.values: Select where to apply the initial condition Auto (default) | Output | Compatibility

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Interval between samples -1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Limit output
params.values: Limit block output values to specified range off (default) | on

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: Upper limit for the integral inf (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Lower saturation limit
params.values: Lower limit for the integral -inf (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Show saturation port
params.values: Enable saturation output port off (default) | on

params.name: Show state port
params.values: Enable state output port off (default) | on

params.name: Ignore limit and reset when linearizing
params.values: Treat block as not resettable off (default) | on

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Select data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed Point

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point | Slope and bias

params.values: Unique name for block state ’’ (default) | alphanumeric string
